column1: # note: Form 1 line 22, the tax on 5.0% income: the instructions say that if line 21 is more than $24,000, multiply it by .05; at $24,000 or less the 2025 tax table on page 38 applies.
# note: The rate is the same for every filing status Form 1 offers. Form 1 has no qualifying surviving spouse status; such a filer files as head of household.
# note: Line 22 is entered in whole dollars.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
